{{Quote|I'll be taking a diving trip to the resort world of Kaal soon, and a friend offered to loan me an organic gill. Catch is, I gotta pick it up. If you help me out, I'll pay you.|An unidentified citizen, to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:AED">{{GalaxiesAED}}</ref>}}
A former [[Rakata/Legends|Rakata]] colony in the [[Pre-Republic era]], '''Kaal''' was a tropical resort [[Planet/Legends|world]]. It was a popular destination for [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] personnel on leave, though military presence was minimal. Following the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], it was the site of a [[Battle of Kaal|confrontation]] between the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]], [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Uther Kermen|Kermen]], and the [[Warlord/Legends|warlord]] [[Utoxx Prentioch]]. The [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] took control of the world.

==Description==
Kaal was located within the [[Kaal system/Legends|Kaal system]], in the [[Yushan sector/Legends|Yushan sector]] of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It was situated on the [[Corellian Trade Spine/Legends|Corellian Trade Spine]], a [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] that connected it to [[Chibias/Legends|Chibias]] and [[Dalisor system/Legends|Dalisor]].<ref name="TEA" /> It was a [[Water/Legends|water]]-dominated [[Planet/Legends|planet]] with a breathable [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]], standard [[Gravity/Legends|gravity]], a saturated hydrosphere, and a tropical climate. Its oceans hosted abundant life, including [[Fish/Legends|fish]] and [[Plankton/Legends|plankton]]. Archipelagos were present on the surface of Kaal, and one such island chain formed a resort [[City/Legends|city]], which contained the world's only [[Spaceport/Legends|starport]]. Abundant casinos, high-class hotels, and other entertainment establishments attracted wealthy individuals and underworld elements to Kaal.<ref name="J7" />

==History==
Kaal was controlled by the [[Rakata/Legends|Rakatan]] [[Infinite Empire/Legends|Infinite Empire]] from around [[30,000 BBY|30,000]] to [[25,200 BBY]]. The region of [[Realspace/Legends|space]] surrounding Kaal was explored during the period from [[8000 BBY|8000]] to [[5500 BBY/Legends|5500 BBY]], and Kaal was within the territory of the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Brotherhood of Darkness/Legends|Brotherhood of Darkness]] during the final [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[New Sith Wars]]. The world was later within space that was controlled by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].<ref name="TEA" />

Kaal was later controlled by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], under which it was a major food production world and a popular retreat for Imperial personnel in the Yushan sector.<ref name="J2" /> The Empire did not exploit Kaal's oceanic life to its full potential, only harvesting enough to support the planet's populace.<ref name="J7" /> The first meeting between [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]] and [[Dash Rendar/Legends|Dash Rendar]] occurred at a [[Sabacc/Legends|sabacc]] table on Kaal.<ref name="SOTES">''[[Shadows of the Empire Sourcebook]]''</ref> The ''[[Emperor's Shadow]]'' plunged into the oceans of Kaal after [[Emperor's Hand/Legends|Emperor's Hand]] [[Jeng Droga]], driven to insanity by the [[Death/Legends|death]] of [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] at the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], slaughtered the [[Yacht/Legends|yacht's]] crew.<ref name="G5">{{GamerCite|5|The Emperor's Pawns}}</ref>

Kaal's status as an Imperial resort world ceased when Imperial troops withdrew following their loss at Endor.<ref name="J7" /> Local [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Tirgee Benyalle]],<ref name="J2" /> who operated Kaal's casinos and entertainment industries,<ref name="J7" /> took control of the planetary government and the agricultural industry<ref name="J2" /> and became the administrator of Kaal.<ref name="J7" /> Benyalle provided several small [[Capital ship/Legends|capital ships]] to defend the system from [[Pirate/Legends|piracy]] and Imperial attacks and to protect food shipments from Kaal to other systems.<ref name="J2" /> Using capital from her casinos, she purchased several immense [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsorlift]] harvesters to gather food from the oceans and prepare the food for sale.<ref name="J7" /> Following the [[Battle of Onderon (Galactic Civil War)|final death]] of Palpatine, Jeng Droga returned to Kaal, waiting for his master's return from the dead once more.<ref name="G5" />
